description: Main window: core IPC, the folder pickers for choosing or creating a vault, the updater, window destroy (the editor saves before it closes the window) and window set-theme (the title bar follows the theme chosen in the app) and window show (the window starts hidden and is shown once the first theme is applied, so the title bar never flashes the OS theme), window set-title (the title reads labnoteO and the vault name, so the vault stays visible when the left sidebar is hidden), and the opener scoped to http, https, mailto and partbank URLs (external links open in the system browser; other schemes are copied instead).
